meta.title: FE Lua binding API reference — 881 class-binding templates (0x158C558..0x1649C84)
meta.method: Per case: beginClass call = the unique-per-case callee (881 distinct type-register helper instances); class name from x1 string or r1 rodata pointer. Members = post-beginClass calls carrying a name (x1 string or rodata va). prop vs fn classified from helper disassembly: property registers allocate a 0x10-byte descriptor and store the (getter,setter) pair (stp after bl 0x114cba0); the single shared function register 0x114f120 links a name to a closure. 1,140 distinct member-register helpers classified (1,139 property + 1 function).

validation.cross_check: dispatcher-881-cases.tsv (Round-8 DispatcherAgent): 0/881 class-name mismatches, 0/881 member-list mismatches (identical prop and fn sets)
validation.template_fn_alignment: case-analysis fn VA == template-fns.json VA for 881/881

meta.namespace_source: Registry mangled type names in runtime rodata (e.g. N11FrameEngine5Logic10LuaManagerE); star/vector classes inherit the base class namespace; SafeRef_ActorSkill / SafeRef_BattleActor from luabridge UserdataValue record names; FixTime and InputBufferActionLogic are [INFERENCE] (no full mangled record name present in the runtime rodata dump).
notes: Duplicate member names (e.g. "track;track") = two separate registrations of the same Lua name through the same helper (getter/setter or overload pairs).
Class names ending "* >" (55 total) are std::vector<T*> style registrations; the runtime rodata name string is exactly "T* >" (e.g. "SkillComboResObject* >").
LuaManager is NOT among the 881 templates; its registry record (0x6A7F428, name N11FrameEngine5Logic10LuaManagerE) carries 11 method slots (island-27 0x1588FC8 family + shared 0x13CED60 family).
